scope: Hybrid handover and its settings; compact AutoTune active-day persistence only

ownership.incidentalGridImport: The existing self_consumption/avoid_import strategy plus plannedChargeW distinguishes incidental source attribution from deliberate charging; gridChargeAssistW calculations and presentation unchanged.
ownership.priorityGuards: Existing Peak Guard/cooldown, overrides, floors, reserves, pauses and EV intentional import retained; explicit safety recovery and EV discharge-protection guards.

minimumHandoverSoc.safety: Handover eligibility only; no change to minSoc/safetySoc/Battery Save or battery commands.

autotune.storage: Existing _autoTuneLearning with unchanged completed-day summaries plus compact currentDay totals.
autotune.routineCheckpoint: Existing slow housekeeping, at most once per five minutes; duplicate totals skipped even if only a time anchor advanced.
autotune.extraFlushes: Existing day-finalization path and graceful app shutdown.
autotune.restart: Restores only valid current-day aggregates; fresh time/stability anchors exclude downtime. Previous active day uses existing finalization validity; history dates prevent duplicate finalization.
autotune.corruption: Invalid active checkpoint discarded without losing historical summaries. Invalid dates/Intl failures cannot block startup.
autotune.reliability: Existing reliableHours rules and recommendation calculations unchanged.
autotune.hybridFeedbackLimitation: Existing Report external EMS battery power card documents actual power, but its handler stores externalSetpointW with no measured-versus-requested source discriminator. Genuine physical measurement cannot be verified from existing data. Delegated hours remain excluded from reliableHours; no inferred power or new input channel introduced.
autotune.physicalPositiveScenario: Not enabled: trustworthy physical provenance unavailable in existing code. Fresh/stable external setpoints explicitly tested as excluded.

couplings.settingsDefaults: Two app-only defaults extend engine defaults in app.js; lib/ems-engine.js unchanged.
couplings.settingsEventGuard: _autoTuneLearning excluded from existing settings-change evaluation callback so persistence never creates extra EMS evaluations.

tests.name: app-control
tests.note: Two synthetic priority fixtures now specify their actual charging/discharging strategy; all existing assertions retained.

skipped: Independent EV/widget, HVAC, boiler, PV and phase-control suites
remainingRisks: No Homey or physical inverter measurements; host tests simulate Homey I/O.
Forced termination can lose observations since the last checkpoint (normally up to five minutes plus the configured slow-heartbeat cadence).
Delegated hours cannot become reliable without verifiable physical battery-power provenance.
